finalText:
Found it: `packages/shared/config.js` was merging layers with `Object.assign`, which replaces whole nested objects like `output` and `sourcemap` instead of merging their keys. So a package overriding just `output.format` was silently losing `output.dir` and `output.entry`, which tripped the bundle stage's completeness check.

I replaced it with a `mergeLayers` helper that merges nested objects one level deep across defaults, package overrides, and CLI flags, so partial overrides at any layer only touch the keys they name. Build and the verify script both pass now.
